title: The covering-transfer hom (surjective + injective-on-G) carries the dyadic obstruction down to every prime quotient AND forward across curve interleaving — one injectivity hypothesis unifies F4, F10, F11
connection: sumsetDistinct_image_eq_univ proves the r-fold distinct-sumset covering transfers under any surjective additive hom injective on G. SAME structural move as Jo26 Theorem 5.7 (GG25ExactPreservation, curve-decodability transfers exactly under interleaving when C(a,b)≤q): both are 'a covering of the small object covers the big object via a hom preserving distinctness'. The covering-transfer pushes the ⟨−2⟩ Mersenne covering to every primitive factor q∣2^m−1 (PrimitiveFactorCovering); the curve interleaving is the code-side analogue. The cyclotomic reduction ℤ[ζ_{2^μ}]↠F_p (degree-1 prime 𝔭|p, the F11 fully-split case) is precisely a covering-transfer hom whose injectivity-on-G is the resultant non-divisibility p∤Res — i.e. the F10 lacunary cleanliness AND the curve-list distinctness are ONE injectivity hypothesis on ONE hom.
why_insightful: Identifies a single algebraic gadget (distinctness-preserving surjection) underlying three in-tree results — Mersenne covering descent, curve interleaving (Jo26 5.7), the cyclotomic lift to F_p — and shows the fully-split prime 𝔭|p (the Pan-Xu open case, F11) is the relevant hom for the prize.
attack_plan: Lean: an abstract DistinctnessPreservingTransfer generalizing sumsetDistinct_image_eq_univ to the curve-close-set image, instantiate with the cyclotomic reduction ℤ[ζ]↠F_p (degree-1 𝔭). The injectivity hypothesis becomes p∤Res(f_S−f_T,Φ_{2^μ}) (not_dvd_collisionResultant). Probe: for fully-split prize primes, measure the density of degree-1 primes 𝔭|p for which the dyadic sumset stays injective vs collapses (the F11/Pan-Xu split-case count).
